title: ProcessModel
description: Process-layer model of a rule's implementation: lanes (actors), activities (who does what, with which artifacts, on what occasion), and edges including rework loops. Sources: 'statute' (mandated skeleton, span-grounded), 'declared' (a jurisdiction's published steps), 'observed' (records). BPMN-lite.

actors.description: Lanes. Canonical: applicant, third_party, planning, building, inspector, official, health_officer, county, fire, state_agency.

optional.description: true if the source says 'may' / offered-not-required

mandated_element.description: For statute-sourced skeletons: the mandated element key (checklist_publication, third_party_option, inspection, correction_permits, fee_waiver, decision, notice).

terminal_artifact.description: What the applicant holds at the end (e.g. 'building permit', 'revocable certificate of compliance').
